<p class="eyebrow">Bio / Profile</p>
<h1 class="landing-title">Macro-finance research, public-data systems, and interpretable market-state updating.</h1>
<p class="landing-copy">I am Jaeseok Hwang, a Ph.D. candidate in Applied Economics at UIUC. My current work centers on a rates and cross-asset scenario updating system that separates prior expectation, structured shock interpretation, realized reaction, covariance-path belief, and ex-post story review.</p>
